_comment: Equal-weighted composite index of five listed UK housebuilders: Persimmon (PSN), Barratt Redrow (BTRW), Taylor Wimpey (TW), Berkeley (BKG), Vistry (VTY). The composite rebases each issuer's close to 100 at the 2019 mean and takes the simple average (rebase2019 divisors per adapters/eodhdHousebuilders.ts: PSN 2010.47, BTRW 603.15, TW 163.26, BKG 4684.43, VTY 919.61). 2026-10-28 refresh: all five closes are from the completed 27 October LSE session in the Yahoo Finance .L daily chart feeds, GBp. The 28 October bars were still in progress before the 16:30 London close and are not used. Rebased to 1 decimal: PSN 1321.5/2010.47=65.7, BTRW 337.9/603.15=56.0, TW 84.8/163.26=51.9, BKG 3536/4684.43=75.5, VTY 276.2/919.61=30.0; unrounded simple mean 55.8427 rounds to 55.8. The observed_at is 16:30 GMT = 16:30 UTC. TODO(source): LSE has no free bulk daily API; the live path is EODHD (fiscal cron, 5 of 20 free-tier calls).
